Loan Account - defect report

Module: Lending Management > Loan account  |  Create / Update / Details / Delete  |  Tested: 2026-08-02

Environment: release.intacct.com (www-p303) | Company SNL_base_303_M | Entity: Lending Management Entity (LME)
Checklist: loan account.xlsx (172 numbered cases) - Passed 124, Failed 34, Untested (blocked) 14.
Total distinct defects: 24.
Active-only filtering verified: an unused category (Loan Cat NoSeq 08), interest rate (LIR Rev 09) and loan type (LT Rev Simple 360) were each set Inactive and confirmed to be excluded from the create dropdowns while active records remained. Delete was retested and works correctly (the earlier list-delete error did not reproduce).
Test data created: 25 loan accounts (LA-COMBO-01..25 plus doc-sequence auto-numbered accounts) covering combinations of category (with/without document sequence, no-sequence), amount (0, 1, decimals, up to 999,999,999), interest rate (zero / negative / standard), Email statements on/off, disbursement recipient + bill number, and one amortized account. All created accounts use the only active Loan type ("Loan Type 01", a revolving type).

Create

Defect #1: Saving the form with a missing Interest rate crashes with a raw Java error instead of a friendly "required" message.

Observed behavior:

Saving a new loan account while the Interest rate is empty shows the raw server error "Cannot invoke com.intacct.ds.snl.model.LoanInterestRate.getKey() because the return value of com.intacct.ds.snl.model.LoanAccount.getLoanInterestRate() is null", together with a JavaScript error "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading placeholders)". This happens even after a Loan type has been selected (which is what makes the Interest rate field appear).

Expected behavior:

A user-friendly validation message such as "Interest rate is required for loan account." should be shown, the same way the other mandatory fields report themselves.

Attachment:

LA-CREATE-emptysave-npe.png

Defect #2: Whitespace-only or empty Account number / Account name are rejected with a message that exposes internal object and field identifiers.

Observed behavior:

Entering only spaces (or leaving them empty) in Account number / Account name and saving shows "A value is required for the field id of object loan-management/loan-account" and "A value is required for the field name of object loan-management/loan-account". These leak internal object and field identifiers.

Expected behavior:

A clean message such as "Account number is required." / "Account name is required." with no internal object or field identifiers.

Attachment:

(no screenshot - reproducible per the steps above)

Defect #3: Enabling "Create amortization schedule" reveals required fields whose validation messages leak internal JSON field paths.

Observed behavior:

Ticking "Create amortization schedule" adds mandatory "Term in months" and "First payment date" fields. Saving without them shows "The /termInMonths is required. This cannot be null." and "The /firstPaymentDate is required. This cannot be null.", which expose internal JSON paths (/termInMonths, /firstPaymentDate).

Expected behavior:

Friendly messages such as "Term in months is required." and "First payment date is required." with no internal JSON paths.

Attachment:

(no screenshot - reproducible per the steps above)

Defect #4: Creating an amortized loan with a 0% interest rate throws a server "/ by zero" (division-by-zero) error.

Observed behavior:

With "Create amortization schedule" ticked and a 0% interest rate ("LIR Rate Zero Test"), saving fails with the raw server error "/ by zero". Switching to a non-zero interest rate lets the account save.

Expected behavior:

A 0% interest rate should either be handled gracefully in the amortization calculation or be rejected with a clear message such as "An interest rate greater than 0% is required to build an amortization schedule."

Attachment:

(no screenshot - reproducible per the steps above)

Defect #5: Interacting with the amortization "First payment date" repeatedly raises raw "InvocationTargetException" errors.

Observed behavior:

Selecting/changing the First payment date on an amortized loan repeatedly pops up raw "InvocationTargetException" error toasts (server 500s).

Expected behavior:

No raw exception should be surfaced; date changes should be handled silently or with a meaningful message.

Attachment:

(no screenshot - reproducible per the steps above)

Observed behavior:

The page-level heading is "Create loan" and the section cards are "Loan information" / "Loan terms" / "Dimensions" / "Disbursement".

Expected behavior:

The heading should be "Create loan account" and the sections should be named consistently (e.g. "Loan account information").

On a new Create loan account form the Email statements checkbox is unchecked.

Defect #8: The Location field is mandatory on save but is not marked with a red asterisk.

Observed behavior:

Saving without a Location fails with "Location is required for loan account.", yet the Location field has no red * to indicate it is mandatory.

Location should display a red * like the other mandatory fields.

Observed behavior:

The Dimensions section contains Department, Location, Project, Employee, Item, Class and Contract. The checklist-specified "Restrictions" and "UDD" fields are absent.

Observed behavior:

Saving an account name longer than 200 characters shows "IA.NAME_SHOULD_NOT_EXCEED_200_CHARACTERS" - a raw i18n key - instead of readable text.

Defect #11: The negative-amount error message exposes an internal JSON field path.

Observed behavior:

Entering a negative Amount and saving shows "The /originationAmount should be positive. Please provide valid input.", which leaks the internal field path "/originationAmount".

A user-friendly message such as "Amount cannot be negative." with no internal field paths.

Defect #12: The Description field is limited to 500 characters, not 1000 as specified.

Observed behavior:

A description between 501 and 1000 characters (which the checklist expects to be accepted) is rejected with "Description should not exceed 500 characters".

Defect #16: The number of tabs on the view page depends on amortization, and does not match the specification.

Observed behavior:

For a loan without an amortization schedule the view shows only Overview and Transaction history; for a loan with an amortization schedule a third "Amortization schedule" tab appears. The checklist expects a fixed set.

Delete

Defect #24: The delete confirmation modal shows a raw, untranslated localisation key instead of the confirmation message.

Observed behavior:

The single-record delete modal shows "IA.SNL_DELETE_LOAN_ACCOUNT_MODAL_CONFIRMATION_MESSAGE" followed by the account name, instead of the expected confirmation text. (The list bulk-delete modal shows no confirmation text at all - only Delete / Cancel buttons.)

Expected behavior:

The modal should show "[Account ID] - [Account Name] will be permanently deleted." (localised).

Attachment:

LA-DELETE-modal-raw-i18n.png
